# OpenTimestamps fixtures

Real proofs and real Bitcoin block headers used by `tests/test_anchor_ots.py`. Nothing here is
generated by this repository; the tests are offline and never fetch these again.

Retrieved 2026-11-16.

## Proofs

Source: <https://github.com/opentimestamps/opentimestamps-client/tree/master/examples>
(raw URL prefix `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opentimestamps/opentimestamps-client/master/examples/`).
The upstream repository is licensed LGPL-3.0; the `.ots` files are data files that this repository
only reads, never links or modifies. Each is checked by a byte-exact parse/serialize round trip.

### gdp2q25-2nd.pdf.ots

- File digest (SHA-256): `c70972a12908b73c2407d9cc6842ba2a02203a690f3090cd29f30c45f0cfd93d`
- Attests: Bitcoin block **912095** (2025, modern difficulty, about 2^78 work).
- Single attestation path, ops in order (tags): `prepend(99 B)` `append(35 B)` then repeated
  `sha256 sha256` pairs each preceded by an `append(32 B)` / `prepend(32 B)` step (Bitcoin
  transaction double-SHA-256 and merkle path), ending in the Bitcoin attestation. The message
  at the attestation equals the block header's merkle root.
- Does **not** use RIPEMD-160, so it verifies on every platform.

## Block headers (`headers.json`)

`{"<height>": {"hash": "<block hash, big-endian hex>", "header": "<80-byte header, hex>"}}` for
heights 912095 and 358391. For each height, `https://blockstream.info/api/block-height/{h}` and
`https://mempool.space/api/block-height/{h}` returned the same block hash, the header came from
`https://blockstream.info/api/block/{hash}/header`, and it double-SHA-256 hashes to that block hash.
